title: Mid-level Blockchain Developer
description: Mid-level blockchain engineer capable of building complex DeFi/NFT protocols, designing UUPS upgradeable proxies, integrating Chainlink Data Feeds and VRF randomness, running Slither and fuzz testing suites, authoring The Graph subgraphs, and deploying across EVM L2s and Solana.

skills.rationale: Designing upgradeable proxies, Chainlink Oracle integration, Vyper contracts, and Yul gas optimization.
Running Slither static analysis, property-based fuzz testing, and frontrunning/MEV mitigation.
DeFi integrations (Uniswap, Aave), custom The Graph subgraphs, and DAO governance.
Deploying across OP Stack, Arbitrum Nitro, Solana SVM, and cross-chain bridge mechanisms.
Architecting across Optimistic and ZK-Rollups, Validium, and gas profiling.
EVM trace debugging in Tenderly and IPFS/Arweave decentralized storage pinning.
Validator staking models, network fork mechanics, and Sybil resistance.
Mempool propagation dynamics and Merkle proof verification.

scoring.description: Weighted average of skill readiness scores multiplied by importance weights.

not_ready.description: Lacks independent smart contract architecture and security auditing skills.

partially_ready.description: Comfortable with basic DeFi, but struggles with proxy patterns, fuzz testing, or cross-chain messaging.

ready.description: Meets all mid-level expectations: delivers upgradeable contracts, Slither audits, subgraphs, and L2 deployments.

exceeds.description: Exceeds mid-level requirements with deep zk-Rollup knowledge and formal verification skills.
